ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  ICICI Life Insurance Limited announced a significant leadership transition with the resignation of its Managing Director and CEO, Mr. Anup Bagchi, effective October 13, 2026, to pursue a new career opportunity. Mr. Sidharatha Mishra, an internal group hire with extensive banking experience, has been appointed as the new Chief Operating Officer immediately and will assume the MD & CEO role from October 14, 2026, subject to regulatory approval. This planned succession indicates an orderly transition at the top, with no immediate red flags identified beyond standard regulatory conditions for the new CEO's appointment.
